description_en: Asynchronously queries the IDs of SQL statements that generate a MySQL error code in the SQL Explorer results of a database instance
description_zh: 调用GetAsyncErrorRequestListByCode接口，异步查询数据库实例SQL洞察结果中产生指定MySQL错误码的SQL ID
name: GetAsyncErrorRequestListByCode

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

This parameter must be specified if the database instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。
对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The start time must be within the storage duration of the SQL Explorer feature of the database instance, and can be up to 90 days earlier than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询开始时间需要在数据库实例SQL洞察存储时长范围内，最大不能早于当前时间90天
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且查询开始时间和查询结束时间的间隔不能超过1天
parameters.name: end

parameters.help_en: The error code. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/409804.html operation to query the MySQL error codes that may be generated in the SQL Explorer results of an instance
parameters.help_zh: 错误码，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/409804.html接口查询实例的MySQL错误码
parameters.name: error_code

true

true

false
isFinish.description_zh:
异步请求是否执行完成：

true：是。

false：否

result.description_zh: 产生指定MySQL错误码的SQL ID列表

items.description_zh: 产生指定MySQL错误码的SQL ID列表

resultId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous request

state.description_en:
The state of the asynchronous request. Valid values:

RUNNING

SUCCESS

FAIL
state.description_zh:
异步请求的执行状态：

RUNNING：正在运行。

SUCCESS：成功。

FAIL：失败

timestamp.description_en: The time when the asynchronous request was made. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
timestamp.description_zh: 执行时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

Success.description_zh:

true：执行成功。

false：执行失败
